deliverables.purpose: Primary horizontal logo with wordmark on a dark background
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. The reference image is the edit target: the horizontal LV Copy Trader logo.
Rebuild this same logo cleanly as a finished digital brand asset. Preserve the angular interlocking LV symbol, its overall proportions, the blue/ice-white palette, the horizontal symbol-plus-wordmark arrangement and the exact text "LV Copy Trader".
Critical correction: all letter strokes and symbol surfaces must be fully solid and clean. Remove every distressed, chipped, missing, noisy, speckled or transparent patch in the lettering and around the contours. Crisp antialiased vector-like edges, smooth solid silhouettes, consistent optical kerning. No rough texture, no drop shadow, no outline around letters.
Place it on a perfectly uniform opaque near-black background #030406, with no transparency or simulated checkerboard. Ice-white "LV" and "Trader", electric-blue "Copy"; keep the LV symbol's restrained blue/ice-blue shading. Wide 3:1 canvas, generous outer padding so nothing touches the edges. No other text, no extra marks, no mockup.

deliverables.purpose: Square app/avatar icon with the same monogram
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished square application icon for LV Copy Trader.
Reference image is the approved identity reference. Use ONLY the angular interlocking LV emblem on its left. Preserve the emblem's exact silhouette, negative-space cuts, ice-blue left part, electric-blue right part, and proportions. Remove the entire wordmark.
Create a single square 1:1 icon. Large emblem, centered optically, occupying about 78 percent of the width, with its original aspect ratio preserved. A full-bleed opaque near-black graphite background #030406 with a very restrained soft blue ambient illumination behind the emblem, matching a polished dark financial software interface. Crisp substantial symbol surfaces, subtle cool material shading only inside the mark, front-facing and calm.
No lettering, no digits, no tagline, no extra glyphs, no charts, no robots, no stars, no money symbols, no mockup scene, no exterior border, no glowing halo. No poster layout. This is one ready-to-use app/avatar icon, with enough safe margin for rounded-square and circle crops.

deliverables.purpose: Simplified blue monogram without wordmark on a dark background
deliverables.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: the simplified mini-logo for LV Copy Trader, for small placements on its near-black website.
Reference image is an identity reference. Keep ONLY the exact angular LV monogram on the left. Keep the same outer shape, the three filled geometric components, the diagonal gaps and original aspect ratio. Remove all the wordmark.
Produce one square 1:1 asset with this monogram centered and occupying 78 percent of the width, on a perfectly uniform opaque near-black background #030406. EVERY component of the monogram must be the identical flat solid blue #52A8FF. Hard clean vector-like geometry with antialiasing only at the outside edge. Absolutely flat colors.
No transparency, no alpha cutout, no gradients, no highlights, no shadows, no glow, no texture, no stray pixels, no lettering, no typography, no frame, no circular container, no rounded-square drawn container. Dark background visible cleanly through both diagonal channels. Preserve a simple bold silhouette for small-use legibility. This is one final actual mini-logo asset, not a presentation sheet.

origin_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: the primary horizontal logo for an existing product, LV Copy Trader, a Telegram-to-MetaTrader signal-copying application with a restrained dark 3D website.
Create ONE finished logo on a genuinely transparent background, landscape approximately 3:1. This is an actual usable logo asset, not a brand board or mockup.
Design a distinctive, compact geometric LV monogram to the left, made from two strong interlocking angular paths: a clearly readable L and V with one clean negative-space channel suggesting a signal moving into execution. Bold solid forms, softly chamfered corners, balanced negative space, extremely clear silhouette at small sizes. Professional contemporary financial software identity, calm and precise.
To the right set the exact text "LV Copy Trader" in a refined modern geometric sans-serif semibold, beautifully kerned, one line. Preserve this spelling exactly. Use soft ice-white #E9F2FF for the lettering and electric blue #52A8FF as a restrained accent in the symbol or "Copy Trader". Symbol and wordmark optically balanced, ample transparent padding, strong horizontal alignment.
Palette comes from the existing project: electric blue #52A8FF, pale ice-blue #B9DDFF and near-white #E9F2FF, designed to be placed on near-black #030406. Do not draw any background, checkerboard, frame or tile. Mostly flat, crisp vector-like edges; at most a very subtle blue tonal transition within the solid monogram. No glow, no soft shadows.
No robot, brain, stars, Telegram logo, MetaTrader logo, candlestick illustration, money sign, coin, stock arrow, generic infinity loop, tagline, badges or extra text. One coherent sophisticated mark, not several options.
